summary: Improve records, request routing, meeting follow-up and office coordination. Review the administrative assistant course curriculum and outcomes.
lede: Administrative assistant training develops practical workflows for routing requests, managing records and coordinating follow-up. Designed for administrative assistants, office support staff and team coordinators, it covers records classification and document controls informed by ISO 15489-1, alongside correspondence and task tracking in Word and Excel. You’ll also practise preparing meeting minutes and action logs, coordinating calendars in Outlook, and reporting on open requests and overdue work.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals whose daily work depends on accurate administrative coordination, controlled records and reliable follow-through.
prerequisites: Basic workplace computer use and familiarity with email are expected. No coding or specialist records-management qualification is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel, Word and Outlook; no separate lab or sandbox is used.
